title: Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Renewal Loyalty Credit: Spend Multiplier Card
content:
The spend multiplier of a Commercial Natural Gas Supply renewal loyalty credit follows the spend the credit is sized on, a net measure of the agreement's posted bill lines with credits and rebill credits included. The base credit, as carried into the loyalty credit, is multiplied by the spend multiplier before any bonus is added.

| Spend | Spend multiplier |
|---|---|
| At or above $30000.00 | 1.5 |
| At or above $15000.00 and below $30000.00 | 1.25 |
| Below $15000.00 | 1 |

## Edges of each band

| Spend | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| $30000.00 | 1.5 |
| $29999.99 | 1.25 |
| $15000.00 | 1.25 |
| $14999.99 | 1 |

## Illustrations (hypothetical carried base credit of $100.00)

- Spend $31200.00: $100.00 multiplied by 1.5 is $150.00.
- Spend $22480.10: $100.00 multiplied by 1.25 is $125.00.
- Spend $9800.00: the multiplier is 1 and the credit stays at $100.00.
